title: Specialization
description: Canonical, app-owned specialization record incl. its talent tree. Ingested ONCE from oggdude_merged.json `specializations` (120 entries, clean dicts). The tree keeps layout-as-data (5 rows × 4 columns, connector links) because RAW purchase eligibility IS the grid (eote p.102). Replaces normalizeOggdude's specMap block.
$comment: INGEST CONTRACT — Universal: 'true'|'false'|ABSENT -> bool, default false (69/120 absent). Source (114) OR Sources (14) -> sources[]. CareerSkills absent on 2 -> empty list allowed but reported. AddlCareerSkills (2/120) -> addl_career_skills. Attributes captured ONLY for non-zero ForceRating (4 universal Force-sensitive specs grant FR 1); all-zero Attributes/Requirements blocks are OggDude editor noise — dropped with the same all-zero integrity check as careers; Requirements with any non-zero member fail loud -> adjudication. TalentRows: Index/Cost/Talents.Key/Directions.Direction coerce; row cost integrity-checked against 5×(row+1) (eote p.102) — mismatch is a REPORT flag, not exclusion (custom content may differ).

universal.description: Purchasable regardless of career (supplement category; core mechanism: any character may buy any spec, non-career +10 XP — fad p.106, eote p.39). Cost treatment of universal specs is an OPEN ITEM (U-CB1) in Docs/RULES_FOUNDATION_CHARBUILD.md.

career_skills.description: The spec's additional career skills; they count as career skills for the PC. Only the STARTING spec grants 2 free ranks from these (eote p.44, p.102).

career_skill_choice_grants.description: PLAYER-CHOSEN career skills: the player picks `count` skills from `pool`, and each becomes a CAREER SKILL for the PC (it does NOT grant a rank). Ruled by `f-eds-6-specializations-full-read` Q1a after the full read found the fact living only in prose (B-40): Republic Representative's printed grant is 'Charm, Cool, Knowledge (choose any one), and Negotiation', so `career_skills` could only ever hold three of its four. DELIBERATE DEVIATION from the ruling's letter, disclosed at the strip gate: Q1a said mirror the species `skill_choice_grants` shape, but that shape REQUIRES `rank_cap` because a species grant confers a RANK. This grant confers career-skill STATUS only — the spec has no free-rank sentence (it is universal; Q3) — so importing `rank_cap` would encode a rank that RAW does not give. The valuable half of the mirror is kept exactly: same `pool` vocabulary and R-ENUM-1 semantics, same generic-by-group resolver that THROWS on an unknown pool (B-36), same validator vocab-coverage arm (L1cb.5's template, extended as L1cb.6).

species_requirement.description: Canonical species id a PC must have to take this spec; the creator prompts a species switch when it does not match. Promoted from the hardcoded `FC_SPEC_SPECIES_REQUIREMENT` map in player/app.jsx (condition C5, ruling `f-eds-6-specializations-full-read` §7) — the same app-shadows-registry class as the deleted FC_CAREER_DESC. One source: the map is retired and the UI reads this field. NOTE (§7, on the record): requiring the Clone species is STRICTER than the printed rule — Dawn of Rebellion p.108 predates the Clone species and says 'human males', so a plain-Human clone would be legal by the book. The mapping stands as ruled unless Jason says otherwise.

restriction_note.description: Short plain-language statement of a printed restriction on who may take this spec. DISPLAYED, NEVER ENFORCED — Jason ruled INFORM (§7 addendum, 2026-07-28): the tool informs the table and polices nothing new. Exists because Retired Clone Trooper's 'must be human males' (Dawn of Rebellion p.108) is a RAW fact whose SEX half has no other carrier in the product (the SPECIES half is enforced structurally via species_requirement). Mechanics voice: state the rule, not the book's prose. Rendered wherever the spec's details teach — picker detail and ADVANCEMENT.

min_force_rating.description: Printed Force Rating prerequisite to take this spec, from OggDude Attributes.Requirement.MinForceRating (1/120: Jedi Knight '2'). Mirrors force-power min_force_rating; the only non-noise Requirement in the data.

bonus_career_powers.description: F-100 M12 Career Powers (R-M12C-86): the tree's two bonus career powers (primer p.5, the tree's row; e.g. Healer Heal/Harm, Protect/Unleash), or the CHOICE form for Padawan and Master. A character's career powers are the career's pair plus every OWNED tree's bonus pair (primer p.4, the Prophet example). Pack-overlay only (D-146); DARK (R-M12B-2).

talent_tree.description: Five rows, top to bottom. Row XP costs are 5/10/15/20/25 (eote p.102). Eligibility: top row, or link-connected to an already-purchased talent (eote p.102).

talents.description: Four columns, left to right. The same ranked talent may appear at multiple positions; each position is a separate purchase (eote p.102).
